programs.title: Reading the Room on the Shop Floor
outcomes: Name emotional states before acting in tense shop-floor moments
Give feedback that can be used without escalation
Repair after conflict with stewards, members or management

sessions.activity: Body-scan check-in: members name three states they were in this week and where each landed in the body, guided by the Self-Reader Guide.
Listening without preparing a reply: paired practice on a real grievance story, then asking instead of assuming with open questions.
Staying in a hard conversation: role-play a post-dispute apology between member and steward, including receiving an apology well.
Saying no at work: script practice for declining unsafe asks and naming emotional labour in collective terms.

programs.data_shared: Anonymised, opt-in counts of emotion-state names and theme tags from check-ins; no grievance content, names or workplace identifiers are ever stored.
programs.consent: Adult members opt in individually with a plain-language form; consent can be withdrawn at any session, and any withdrawn learner's data is deleted from shared models.

programs.title: Feelings, Friends and Repair at the Lake
outcomes: Name what you feel before you act
Ask instead of assume when reading a classmate
Apologise properly and receive an apology kindly

sessions.activity: Grove walk and journal: learners name three states from this week and draw where each feeling lands in their body.
Face-reading game with the Other-Reader Guide: observe without deciding what it means, then ask one kind question.
Room with a newcomer: group exercise noticing who is idle or left out and practising when to do nothing versus when to step in.
Repair circle: practice a proper apology and how to receive one kindly, using simple sentence starters.

programs.data_shared: Only aggregated, anonymous counts of feeling words used and session themes; no individual responses, drawings or names are collected.
programs.consent: Guardian/parent written consent required before participation, plus the learner's own assent; facilitators explain privacy in child-friendly language and any learner can stop at any time without giving a reason.

programs.title: Empathy Under Pressure: Field Staff Practice
programs.grade_or_level: Professional development / NGO field and programme staff
outcomes: Stay in hard conversations with communities and colleagues
Read the room before a moment goes wrong

sessions.activity: Reading the energy in the room: facilitators replay field-meeting scenarios, practising spotting the moment before it goes wrong.
Saying the hard thing kindly: role-play delivering difficult news to a community partner and repairing after a misstep.
Transfer check with the Self-Reader Guide: name three states from the field this week and locate them in the body before planning responses.
The colleague who is struggling: noticing signs, offering usable support, and naming emotional labour limits on the team.

programs.data_shared: Opt-in, anonymised theme-frequency data on which practice scenarios staff found hardest; no case, beneficiary or location data is ever shared.
programs.consent: Staff opt in individually; data is anonymised at the point of capture, and participants may decline sharing while still taking part in sessions.

programs.title: Repair and Feedback Culture for Small Nonprofits
outcomes: Make feedback usable across staff and volunteers
Apologise well and leave roles well
Hold a shared language for emotional states

sessions.activity: Feedback that can be used: pairs rewrite real (anonymised) internal feedback using the Practitioner Guide's prompts.
Coming down and apologising properly: practice a full repair after a team friction, including how to receive the apology.
Listening without preparing a reply: volunteer-manager pairs practise on leaving-well conversations.
Team check-in ritual: each person names one state and where it sits in the body, building a shared weekly practice.

programs.data_shared: Aggregated, anonymous counts of session themes and check-in feeling words to improve the shared empathy models; no individual names, roles or internal organisational content.
programs.consent: Individual opt-in with a short plain-language notice; volunteers and staff consent separately, withdrawal is honoured immediately, and no data is shared for anyone who opts out.
